name: WindowControls
purpose: Cluster of three TrafficLight discs in a macOS-style group, with glyphs shown on group hover. Used in the window title bar, the settings windows and the trash pane close light.

values.when: Close, minimise and full screen all act. Main title bar, multi-inspector, filter panel, draft inspector.
Only close acts; minimise and full screen are inert. Settings windows and the trash pane close light (Close Trash).

props.name: focused
props.description: Window focus (useWindowFocused); lit when true, grey when false. Passed to each disc.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Closes the window, or the pane for Trash (setTrashOpen(false)). The caller sets the target.

props.name: onMinimize
props.description: Minimise action; inert when live is close.

props.name: onFullScreen
props.description: Full-screen action; inert when live is close. B's spelling onFullscreen is the same prop.

keyboard: Not in the reference. Proposed: each live disc is a focusable button with its own label (Close, Minimize, Full Screen). Tab moves between live discs; Enter or Space activates; inert discs are skipped. No arrow navigation.
replaces: traffic-light cluster, settings (close live, others inert)
platform: Desktop only, macOS look. Web has no native window to close. Windows and Linux need their own caption controls; the catalogue has none.
open: Pane close: the Trash close light closes the pane, not the window. Same look; the caller sets onClose. B asks whether pane close should be WindowControls on desktop and an IconButton on web; decide one widget for both. Trash appears in both the all-live and the close-only rows in the catalogue (B); A records close-only. Settings cluster: source records disabled=[2] for the group, but the Light rows mark minimize and fullscreen inert (uncertain). Draft Light onClick handlers and settings-general and settings-shortcuts Light onClick targets were not read.
